singular_version: Singular for x86_64-Linux version 4.4.1 (44105, 64 bit) Dec  6 2025 11:10:58
conditions: Fresh processes, one discarded run of each solver, alternating measured order, CPU, QQ, single germ at the origin. Atlas prints the complete CLI JSON. Singular loads classifyMapGerms.lib, uses (c,ds), calls coDimMap(f), and prints entry 2. All runs check finite status and codimension.

general_jet_profile.conditions: Pinned CPU 15, g++ -O3, standalone native calls with parsed maps, analytic shortcuts and graded graph disabled to select the same general solver. All intermediate vectors use small-pivot rational echelon forms. Before propagates target products using arbitrary representatives modulo the Jacobian, after uses canonical reduced representatives. Seven alternating before/after batches for each input. Each batch averages 8 solves for dense_plane and 15 solves for every other case.

stage_timing.conditions: Each of 9 pairs measures one solve in a fresh process, alternating order. Sum of timers over all attempted jet degrees. Profile probes use steady_clock and are excluded from the full kernel and CLI timings.

special_profile.conditions: 13 alternating before/after trials; parse once per process, 2 discarded warms, CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID, logical CPU 7; nanoseconds per C++ ae_special call; compiled -O3 -DNDEBUG with g++, linked to Atlas libgroebner and native dependencies; arbitrary-precision rational coefficients; the one-dimensional iso_nonmonomial case measures the special precheck declining, not a complete ae_codimension computation.

mixed_scalar_phases.conditions: pre-parsed two-variable rational germ; warmed operations, CPU 7, process thread CPU nanoseconds, nine rounds of 3,000 repetitions. Individual substage timings are isolated measurements.

mixed_scalar_euler.conditions: warm C++ call on parsed polynomials; CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID; pinned to logical CPU 7; 200 evaluations per trial and 13 trials per version, alternating order

version_labels.candidate: coprime basis criterion, staircase length and nilpotence bound

graded_graph_profile.conditions: C++ timing harness, 9 trials, 35 repetitions per trial, logical CPU 8. One warmup per mode. Alternate mode order each trial. All solves check agreement before measurement. Times are microseconds per call. Isolated stage timings are medians of seven samples, in microseconds.

modes.initial: Direct graded elimination using generic wide Gröbner transport
modes.packed: Direct graded elimination using the packed Gröbner basis when admissible
modes.parse: Parse each map component as a rational polynomial
modes.solve: Complete native Ae computation using parsed map components

double_cover_profile.conditions: 7 alternating trials of the complete native ae_codimension operation on pre-parsed QQ polynomials with one warm repetition. Native benchmark executable, logical CPU 7, steady wall time. For wide-S the old method only reaches a lower bound, so the two results have distinct certification statuses.

result.reason: The exact jet work limit was reached before a finite or infinite codimension was certified.
